items: (f) Loosen the idler pulley set bolt stretch the timing belt.
(g) Tighten the idler pulley set bolt.

content.text: Make sure that the timing belt tension at A is equal to that at B. If not, retighten the idler pulley set bolt.

content.description: Hand turning crankshaft pulley with timing belt installed

items: (h) Turn the crankshaft clockwise two times and set the No. 1 cylinder to TDC/compression.
(i) Recheck the camshaft timing pulley marks.

content.description: Camshaft timing pulley showing EX and IN positions with arrows indicating cleaning

items: (a) Clean the camshaft match holes with compressed air.

content.description: Diagram showing alignment of match holes on camshaft and camshaft housing for both EX and IN sides

items: (b) Align the match hole of the camshaft with that of the camshaft housing by turning the crankshaft pulley.
(c) After alignment, make a note of the crankshaft pulley angle on the No. 1 timing belt cover.

content.text: Match hole alignment should be done separately for the IN and EX sides.
If the camshaft pulley angle is within TDC ± 5°, it is correct.
If it exceeds TDC ± 5°, proceed to step 9.

items: (a) Using SST to hold the camshaft timing pulley, remove the pulley set bolt.

content.text: Do not make use of the timing belt tension when loosening the bolt.
